A perfect place for a Work Date...
Jul 2024 • Friends
If you’re ever around Ho Chi Minh City and looking for a little oasis in the middle of the chaos, Bason Lounge and Cafe at The Myst Dong Khoi Hotel is a must-visit. I stopped by here recently and was completely charmed by the vibe. It feels like a hidden gem—cozy, warm lighting, and tons of plants that make it feel like a mini retreat.

The drinks? Amazing. I had an iced matcha latte that was super refreshing, not too sweet, with just the right amount of matcha kick. They clearly know what they’re doing because the flavors were so well-balanced. I also tried one of their special blended matcha drinks, which came with a little twist of fresh fruit and a sprinkle of coconut on top. It tasted as good as it looked—perfect for a warm day!

What really made my experience, though, was the staff. They were so friendly and welcoming, always around when you needed them but never hovering. The barista even took a moment to chat about the matcha blend they use, which gave the experience a personal touch. It’s one of those places that doesn’t just make good drinks; it makes you feel at home. Whether you're there to relax, read, or just sip on something delicious, I couldn’t recommend Bason Lounge more.

A pleasant environment to work
Jan 2023 • Friends
This cafe is inside the Myst hotel. They have two spaces, one outside in front of the hotel and one inside which is more private and quiet. We came at around 7pm, it is not crowded. We really enjoyed the atmosphere here, it was warm and peaceful. I had salted coffee which was quiet good. My friends had chicken salad and seafood pasta. It is an ideal place to enjoy a nice breakfast in the morning with a cup of coffee. You can also bring your laptop and work here.
